_comment.intent: Wire up the SDK Event Destinations epic: re-parent the two rewritten stories onto it, and record the dependency order.
_comment.dependency_order: MTSDK-76 (re-architect the event engine) blocks the two platform implementations, because it decides the model they implement. The two platform implementations block MTSDK-77, because there has to be generated routing before drift can be checked. MTSDK-78 blocks MTSDK-79, because nothing can stop being forwarded until it is agreed what should still be sent.
_comment.placeholders: MTSDK-76 / MTSDK-77 / MTSDK-78 / MTSDK-79 / MTSDK-75 are replaced with real keys once 25 and 26 are committed and Jira assigns them.
_comment.link_direction_warning: jira-relate.sh applies the link type's OUTWARD description to inwardIssue and the INWARD description to outwardIssue, so 'A blocks B' is inwardIssue: A, outwardIssue: B. The script had this backwards on 2026-07-14 and silently created 22 inverted Blocks links; it was fixed 2026-07-15. This file uses the script's own blocker/blocked keys, which is the corrected interface - but the OK lines it prints are not evidence. Read the graph back with the API and diff it against the dependency_order above before calling this done.
_comment.not_touched: No links to MTSDK-33, MTSDK-35, MTSDK-36, MTSDK-67 or MT-1480, per Filippo 2026-07-15. Jira links are bidirectional, so linking any of them would modify them. MTSDK-33 and MT-1480 are named in prose in the ticket descriptions instead. The existing MTSDK-13 <-> MTSDK-17 clone link is left untouched.
